items.title: Wire scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs into the lattice validate battery
items.context: Add a test:koala-residue npm script (node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs) and include it in the package.json `test` chain so lattice validate (which uses npm test as its fallback battery) runs the gate on every validate. Confirm lattice validate now exercises the gate.
items.userSees: npm test includes a passing test:koala-residue step; lattice validate runs the gate

happy.desc: cat package.json | jq .scripts["test:koala-residue"] -> "node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs"; WHY: confirms the npm script is defined correctly
cat package.json | jq .scripts.test -> string contains test:koala-residue; WHY: confirms the gate is wired into the test chain
npm run test:koala-residue -> exits 0 with PASS output; WHY: confirms the individual script runs successfully via npm
npm test -> exits 0 and output includes koala-residue PASS line; WHY: confirms the full test chain exercises the gate

edge.desc: npm run test:koala-residue -- --self-test -> exits 0, prints 5/5 classify() unit tests; WHY: confirms the self-test mode is accessible through the npm script
run lattice validate -> output includes koala-residue gate pass or npm test chain passes; WHY: confirms lattice validate exercises the gate as part of its fallback battery

adversarial.desc: temporarily corrupt scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs (e.g. syntax error), run npm test -> exits non-zero, test chain fails at test:koala-residue step; WHY: confirms the wiring is real -- if the gate script breaks, the test chain catches it rather than silently skipping

remove test:koala-residue from package.json test chain but leave the script defined, run npm test -> exits 0 but gate is NOT exercised (output has no koala-residue line); WHY: confirms that merely defining the script is not enough -- it must be in the test chain to be exercised
